completed_at.description: Date the training was completed (or the log date), where the source records one.

estimated_hours_required.description: Hours the source says are required **before** a VOC assessment; a planning figure, not delivery.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting/reporting period the record falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: Source form template identity, where the source is form-backed; distinguishes log from request without parsing answers.

occurred_at.description: When the training was logged/requested (source `submitted_time`); the event time and the period key.

provider_name.description: Training provider / registered training organisation (RTO) named on the record.

record_kind_note.description: Free-text comments/notes the tenant attaches to the record.

training_cost.description: Cost of external training, where stated.

training_kind.description: Whether the activity is a completed log entry or a **request**, and whether it is statutory/licence training, a scheme card, or internal.

training_title.description: What the training was — the course/programme name as recorded (log) or requested (request form).

worker.description: The worker trained or requesting training; the record's subject and its accountability anchor.
